data.body:
Correction to the earlier conclusion that this fix "will land without manual intervention once the deferral clears" — it will not, and cannot, under the current autodeploy.

Established on box i-00880b2c7f13527c5 during the 2026-08-28 /review/ 502 incident: `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` is absent from EVERY component path manifest in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (BOT_PATHS, SECRETS_PATHS, MCP_PATHS, CONFIG_PATHS, OBS_PATHS, CERTBOT_PATHS). Autodeploy's only nginx write is the MCP blue-green pointer swap against the separate `/etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` include (autodeploy.sh:160, :528) — it never regenerates `rebar.conf`.

That is exactly why the 23:21 deploy moved the MCP container to `rebar-mcp-25ea12c200ae-8092` while `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` still shows `mtime=2026-08-27 22:05:26 +0000` with 7 `proxy_redirect` directives — the pre-a61d shape. Change `25fd2cf6dd75` is merged but not live and will stay that way indefinitely.

Filed as `downy-feminist-leopard` (1d1b-a719-b675-4a1f), linked relates_to here. This ticket is effectively blocked on that one: verifying a61d live at the edge requires the edge to actually deploy. Note the failure is silent — the edge does not even get the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` detect-and-signal treatment `CONFIG_PATHS` receives.
